template.name: Propose a talk
template.description: Take an open slot at the Engineering CoP. An admin confirms every talk before it joins the agenda.
template.intro: Everything on this page is public on GitHub. Use your GitHub username only, with no email addresses. Prefer the schedule site: it fills this form in for you.

fields.label: Session date
fields.help: The date of an upcoming session with an open slot, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.label: GitHub username
fields.patternMessage: That doesn't look like a GitHub username.
fields.help: Who is presenting. Admins filing for someone without an account may write their name here.

fields.label: Talk title
fields.placeholder: What you'll cover, in a line

fields.label: Format
fields.help: Must be a format open on the date you chose.

fields.label: Abstract
fields.placeholder: A few sentences for the agenda.
